name: vectorcraft
description: Logos, icon sets, infographics, SVG cleanup and multi-artboard variants. Exports SVG, PDF and PNG with editable paths.

interface.shortDescription: 标志、图标集、信息图与 SVG 清理，多画板变体，导出 SVG/PDF/PNG 且路径可编辑。
interface.longDescription: Use independently maintained, checksummed skills to install pinned native CLIs and create editable native projects. Development release; complete capability and host acceptance remain in progress.
